newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile shares slump to close at new year low.
newsitem.headline: Chile shares slump to close at new year low.

text.p: Chilean blue chips tumbled in light trade to close at a new year-low of 87.88 points with the market seen continuing soft this week due to the Christmas holiday, said traders.
"Last week the positive mood came from abroad. With foreigners absent this week, sentiment is soft," said one dealer.
The selective index closed unofficially off 0.87 percent at 87.88 points. The general index shed 0.4 percent to 4,873.44 points.
Volume shrank to 7.6 billion pesos from 14 billion pesos Friday.
Traders said the bolsa's mood was dampened by Central Bank figures showing the economy grew a stronger-than-exepected 7.7 percent in October.
Analysts had been expecting the monthly Imacec index to register growth of around 6.7 percent.
"People were surprised by the figure, especially after the 5.5 percent increase seen in September," said Guillermo Tagle, head of research at Santander Investment.
Heavyweight electricity stocks fell on fears that this year's drought will hurt generating companies' earnings, said traders.
Enersis lost 2.35 percent to 218-1/2 pesos while generator Endesa declined 0.47 percent to 213 pesos.
Winners included drug-maker LabChile, up 1.43 percent at 355 pesos, forestry firm Masisa, up 0.56 percent at 178 pesos and pension fund manager Provida which firmed 0.37 percent at 7,840 pesos.
